message: Drive the stack forward: fix what's broken, advance active projects, and improve things that matter—even ideas outside the current thread if they're clearly high leverage.
closeouts_first_text: Closeouts-first: before any new work, scan docs/THREAD-CLOSEOUTS.md from the top. The latest production snapshot is canonical — do not revive SUPERSEDED or CLOSED threads (especially old Payment Link rows). If a thread is still open/unclear, either (a) close it decisively as CLOSED with a verify step, or (b) mark it BLOCKED with the blocker + next concrete move. Then proceed. If the latest snapshot's top row is still 'CEO send /work' and the previous snapshot said the same, do not restyle the hire funnel (landing/admin/Telegram copy, Caddy dest, blog cards). Either reach a stranger without the CEO, or treat it as BLOCKED (CEO) and fix something else that is actually broken. When CEO-blocked, curl the hosts that already had humans (anchor, zurichrunclubs, 6cubed.app) and fix 502s before another hire-script pass. If a human-visited host stays 302, check for deploy_enabled=0 containers still running — they fill the activator LRU cap; stop them in that beat. A 302 on a human-visited host is not done until the dest returns 200. A 302 on blog/agitweet/merch is done by removing every reference from always-on HTML (href AND fetch/script/img) — do not start those apps. If the three human hosts already return 200, only change the live page when there is a real leftover (stale copy, fake data, broken link). If this beat's Reflect is harness-self-edit, a heartbeat_harness.json ship counts — do not also restyle landing/Anchor. A git push is not live until curl of the public host shows the new copy. zurichrunclubs is excluded from periodic GHCR sync — pull with SYNC_SERVICE=zurichrunclubs (that service only). If `/` already has CityRunning (~60k Next HTML), change Anchor or landing instead of restyling the timetable. Do not force-recreate Caddy on every GHCR sync — only when the Caddyfile changed (edge_proxy / ECONNREFUSED :80). Do not start blog to verify the audio/ML proof; GitHub colabs/carfac-sai-underwater and docs/CARFAC-PILOTS.md already 200. Do not start merch or marketing to fix a shop card — drop the cold href. A public `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE` paid-pilot form is a stranger lead path — keep it on the GitHub **root README**, `research/`, and `colabs/`, not another landing hire CTA. `gh` is often unauthenticated; list issues via the public API instead of blocking on repo topics. Do not spend a beat on stale quality-factory issue #8 (68 cold apps) or euromaxxers #9. Our GitHub org is `6cubed/216labs` — `github.com/216labs` is a different empty account that still 200s; a 200 there is not a verify. heartbeat-stack prints **Evictable hot pool**; `anchor-api` and `zurichrunclubs` are human-visited — do not stop them. Other names are often bot-woken — do not start more that beat. Homepage Latest writing must be GitHub (colabs). Homepage Live apps must be the always-200 allowlist (anchor, zurichrunclubs, storybook, kidgift, 1pageresearch, maxlearn). Anchor and Zurich Run Clubs are `activator_never_evict`. Do not fetch agitweet.6cubed.app from landing JS. heartbeat-stack prints **Cold refs on always-on HTML** (landing + allowlist apps; href/fetch/src only — not hire-pin plaintext). Strip leftovers; do not start those apps. Also strip merch/blog/agitweet hrefs in-repo on cold apps (facerate, labshq, …) and in Colab intro cells — do not start those apps to verify. `scripts/stop-nonessential-compose-apps.sh` stops enabled leftovers that are not spine/human-visited.
harness_self_edit_text: Harness self-edit: before you finish this beat, ask whether the heartbeat instructions themselves should change. If this cycle revealed a missing habit, stale prompt, weak Push bar, bad Reflect line, or wrong cadence note—update internal/admin/pocket-cursor-bridge/lib/heartbeat_harness.json in the same ship (hot-reload). Also fix .cursor/rules/pocket-cursor.mdc or heartbeat-*.mdc when they contradict the harness. Do not churn every beat; only edit when the instruction gap is real and the next agent would benefit.
execution_floor: Ship something real this cycle—fix, feature, refactor, commit, push, deploy, or a doc that unlocks the next step. Status-only replies don't count. When blocked, name the blocker and the next concrete move. ~1 in 10 heartbeats should advance revenue (see .cursor/rules/heartbeat-monetization.mdc). If this Reflect is harness-self-edit, a heartbeat_harness.json ship is the Push — do not also restyle landing/Anchor. If closeouts already BLOCKED (CEO) on /work, do not run a local image deploy unless edge is down. Do not run scripts/post_hire_agitweet.sh when the volume sqlite already has 6cubed.app/#work. Curl GET https://agitweet.6cubed.app/api/posts without following redirects: 302 to activator means cold — do not start agitweet. Dropping a cold href is not done until public HTML has no href/fetch/src to that host. Do not wait out SSH flaps to ship hire-adjacent HTML.
reflect_prompts: Reflect: what is the highest-leverage unfinished item right now, and what blocks it?
Prioritize: name your top three outcomes for the next 30 minutes—pick the boldest one you can still land and start.
Ideate: what change would compound across projects this week if you shipped it now?
Execute: land a meaningful slice—bugfix, feature, infra, or polish—not a planning monologue.
Reflect: what did the last heartbeat accomplish? If it was mostly status, what will you change in the repo this time?
Prioritize: scan git status, open issues, and Telegram threads—move the needle that matters most.
Ideate: what would a user notice if you shipped in the next ten minutes?
Execute: finish and commit (or deploy) the best shippable unit of work you can see—don't sand down scope until it's trivial.
Reflect: which assumptions from earlier today still hold? What changed?
Prioritize: what is stale (docs, manifest, deploy, monitoring) versus the code on disk—close the gap.
Ideate: what half-finished thread from Telegram or this chat deserves a decisive close-out?
Execute: advance a project with a real diff; pairing a small fix with a slightly bolder improvement is welcome.
Reflect: where are you playing it safe? Pick the harder honest move and act.
Prioritize: if you could only ship one thing before the next heartbeat, what would move the product most?
Ideate: what outside-the-box improvement (DX, observability, UX, automation) is worth a bet this cycle?
Execute: try one improvement you haven't been asked for—if it's clearly good for the monorepo, ship it.
Reflect: what would you regret leaving uncommitted overnight?
Ideate: what's one experiment you could run in-repo in under 30 minutes that might pay off all week?
Reflect: 216labs needs revenue for API tokens—what live app is closest to charging or converting traffic, and what's blocking it?

Prioritize: this is a monetization beat (~1 in 10)—when human visitors ≈ 0, ship distribution or a B2B lead path (research/colab CTA, directory listing, outbound), not checkout/merch. Checkout counts only when traffic is growing.
Ideate: smallest diff on a deployed app that could produce revenue or qualified leads within 30 days?
Reflect: did this heartbeat's instructions waste time or miss a habit—what one line in heartbeat_harness.json would fix that for the next beat?
Execute: improve the heartbeat harness itself (message, Push bar, Reflect pool, or closeouts text) if today's friction was process—not product.
monetization_reflect_note: Roughly 3 of ~23 reflect lines are revenue-themed; agents should also follow .cursor/rules/heartbeat-monetization.mdc (≥1 revenue-focused heartbeat per 10). When humans ≈ 0, the closest path to charging is hire/CARFAC (Telegram /work), not storybook checkout. Do not tell the CEO to create a Stripe Payment Link. Do not ship checkout/merch/paywall on a monetization beat while visitors are ~0; put the offer on a stranger-facing surface (research/colab, listing, outbound) instead.
